snippet.title: The Cascadier - Early Prototype Trailer
snippet.description:
Short sample of our in prototype (concept) indie game "The Cascadier" showing a very early sample of how game rounds may look in the final version, and some music too, enjoy!

Crowdfunding launches June 25th on Kickstarter, sign up for the mailing list here: https://www.backerkit.com/call_to_action/d19b138c-dd0b-4ebc-acd2-609d5d091f4a/landing
